NEET UG State Counselling

85% of government MBBS/BDS seats (and all private college seats) are filled through state counselling. Find your state's authority and colleges.

Domicile matters

State quota seats are usually reserved for candidates domiciled in that state (rules differ — e.g. schooling years, parents' residence).

Separate registration

Each state runs its own registration, fee, merit list and choice filling — independent of MCC. You can take part in both.

Private colleges

Government-quota and management/NRI seats of private colleges in the state are filled through state counselling, often open to all-India candidates.
